applies_to: Guidewire PolicyCenter 10.x / Guidewire Cloud / earlier on-premise
info_to_collect: Policy, term, audit job number and audit type (final, interim, revision, non-compliant)
Each GL exposure: class code, location/state, basis type (payroll, sales, area, units), estimated and audited basis
Whether Products-Completed Operations applies; limits (each occurrence / aggregate)
Expected premium and direction vs premium shown
Mid-term changes (class added/removed, location or limit change) and dates; keyed by auditor or automation; screenshots
title: GL premium change reaches Billing or the data warehouse wrongly
symptoms: Written-off premium returns to the balance after a GL endorsement
Invoice billed wrong after a prior-term GL change or audit
GL audit premium in the data warehouse differs from PolicyCenter
cause: A premium delta from a GL endorsement, audit or prior-term change is billed to the wrong term or invoice, reverses an earlier write-off, or is extracted with stale values.
diagnosis: Reconcile the PolicyCenter GL transaction against Billing charges and the data warehouse row
resolution: Correct the billing instruction or Billing adjustment
permanent_fix: Fix charge mapping for prior-term and write-off scenarios; three-way reconciliation report.
escalation: Integration Support + Billing Support; DW Support for extracts.
